title: Structure catalogue
description: Building types. A structure is a contiguous run of same-symbol tiles on a map: it blocks movement, absorbs fire, shelters a garrison, and leaves passable rubble when it falls. Masonry is not armour — how much a round hurts a building is a property of the round, not a penetration roll.

symbol.description: Map legend character. Must not collide with terrain symbols . 1 2 3.

hp_per_tile.description: Structural integrity per tile of footprint: a bigger building is a tougher one.

garrison_slots.description: How many units can fight from inside. 0 = not garrisonable.

per_tile.description: Every tile of this type is its own structure, with its own HP and its own sprite. For linear structures -- walls, fences -- whose runs are of arbitrary length, and where a breach must be a one-tile hole rather than a whole vanished perimeter. Note this makes roe_penalty a per-tile charge. A compact building leaves this false.

wall_tone.description: Presentation only: the palette step (band.index) a mesh building's wall role draws exactly, instead of the lit step of the slice `color` starts. For a wall whose wanted tone is its band's lightest step, which no `color` key can draw.

wall_self_lit.description: Presentation only: a self-lit term on the wall role, as a fraction of its albedo. Lifts a face the scene sun never reaches, without touching the sun or the shared lights.

roe_penalty.description: ROE cost when the player brings this building down. A shed is nothing; a civic hall is a strategic defeat dressed as a tactical win. Note that a per_tile type is charged per tile.

low_profile.description: Chest-high: blocks movement and shields whoever is hugging it, but sight and fire pass over it. For fences and perimeter walls. A compound built from sight-blocking masonry is a blind box whose garrison cannot shoot out, so the wall ends up protecting the besieger.

standing_cover.description: Cover level for a unit fighting from immediately behind this while it stands -- the companion to rubble_cover, which is what remains once it does not. Only consulted for a low_profile type.

garrison_cover.description: Cover level 0-3 a unit INSIDE this building fights with: what incoming suppression is scaled by (COVER_SUPP) and what its detection signature is scaled by (COVER_SIG). Default 3, full building cover (lead ruling 2026-10-14, GH-280). Only read for a garrisoned unit.

floors.description: Storeys a garrison fights from. Each floor above the ground adds one elevation level to the eye height of a unit inside it, for line of sight, the way ground elevation does (lead ruling 2026-10-14, G3). Derived from the drawn height: round(height_px / 10), at least 1.

produces_for.description: Which side this structure builds units for. Present ONLY on production structures -- the seven civilian types are neutral terrain and carry no owner at all, because nothing needed one until a camp did. While a living structure of a type with produces_for === side stands, that side's requestBuild deploys beside it; destroying every one of them stops that side's production. Missions with no such structure fall back to the mission's own player_start, which is what keeps every mission authored before this feature working unchanged.

owner.description: Field works (#277): the default OWNER of a structure of this type. -1 = neutral terrain, as every pre-existing type is. 0 or 1 = a side's building: a target to the other side once seen. Overridable per mission placement. Distinct from produces_for (what it builds).

buildable.description: Field works (#277): the player may raise this in a mission whose field_works lists it. Requires owner 0 (validate_works.mjs).

aura.description: Field works (#277): what a COMPLETE structure owned by a side does for that side. Overlapping auras take the max, never stack.

affects.description: foot = ground infantry; vehicle = ground vehicle; any = both. Air is excluded from every scope.

heal_per_s.description: Fraction of max HP restored a second. The delay is REGEN_DELAY_TICKS, not a field.

repair_components_s.description: Continuous covered, undamaged seconds that clear a mobility or firepower kill.

range_bonus.description: Tiles, direct fire only, ON TOP of the global GARRISON_RANGE_BONUS.

sight_bonus.description: Tiles added to the occupants' sight from the window.

tunnel_radius.description: Tiles inside which any tile of a tunnel route identifies it to the owner, with no line of sight. A mission that authors a digs or in_tunnel placement may not field a type with this above 0 (validate_works.mjs).
